# Sample Document for RAG Tools Testing

This is a test document used to verify the ingestion and search pipeline.

## Introduction

RAG Tools is a browser-local knowledge base that lets you search your documents
using semantic understanding rather than just keyword matching.

## Key Features

- 100% local processing — your data never leaves your browser
- No server, no signup, no installation required
- Supports PDF, TXT, and MD files
- Uses all-MiniLM-L6-v2 for generating embeddings (23MB model)
- IndexedDB for persistent storage

## Technical Details

The embedding model produces 384-dimensional vectors. All vectors are L2-normalized,
so cosine similarity is equivalent to dot product. The search performs a full scan
over all vectors in the selected knowledge base, which is fast enough for personal
use (under 200ms for 100K vectors).

## Test Expectations

When this document is processed:
- It should be chunked into segments of approximately 512 characters
- Each chunk should be embedded as a Float32Array(384)
- The chunks should be searchable via semantic search

Searching for "vector embedding" should return chunks from the Technical Details section.
Searching for "browser local" should return chunks from the Key Features section.
